component.name: Musico Online
component.summary: Local-first music player with an online catalog

description.p: Musico Online is a desktop music player that keeps your library, playlists, listening history and recommendations on your own machine. It combines a local folder scanner and a real audio engine with an online catalog layer, so music you own and music you find live in one library.

ul.li: Search and play from public online catalogs, with album, artist and playlist pages.
Scan local folders and manage saved albums, artists, tracks and playlists.
Batch downloads with a configurable disk cache, retry and resume.
Synced lyrics with karaoke highlighting, romanization and translation.
Gapless playback, crossfade, equalizer, loudness normalization and AutoEQ profiles.
An on-device recommender that learns from listens, skips, likes and audio features.
Native media integration: MPRIS on Linux, SMTC on Windows, Now Playing on macOS.

description.p: No account is required and no listening data is uploaded. The online catalog depends on third-party services, so availability of individual tracks can vary over time.
